rules: Name an exact duty assignment only when a person's capability materially gates a real institutional output; derive that assignment for the current settlement and never store it on the person.

Routine kitchens, cleaning, records handling, storage handling and stable work are derived as faction-level service overhead from current population and infrastructure; they are not permanent person labels.
Specialist duty consumes finite time and therefore reduces that person's institutional training availability.
Specialist assignments are deterministically reassessed from current institutional need, capability and availability. No duty history or hourly schedule is stored.
